name: Froxel Volumetric Fog with Precomputed Lighting
definition: A rendering technique that simulates light scattering inside a volume (mist, smoke, atmospheric fog) by dividing camera space into a 3D grid of voxels, where each voxel stores fog density and lighting information, and rendering samples this volume while marching along the camera ray.
summary: Froxel Volumetric Fog with Precomputed Lighting is a real-time rendering technique that simulates light scattering in participating media by dividing the view frustum into voxels and using precomputed lighting passes for shadows, balancing visual fidelity and performance.
